generation_prompt:
Create a landscape hospital analytics dashboard infographic titled "Hospital performance dashboard to improve operations". Include a subtitle summarizing that the slide focuses on hospital performance metrics such as total patients, expenses, satisfaction, average waiting time, and staff per department.

Divide the main content into dashboard sections in this reading order:

Section 1: "Admission by Department". List these departments: "Gynaecology", "Surgery", "Orthopedics", "Neurology", "Cardiology", "Oncology", "Dermatology".

Section 2: "Admission vs Cost Over Time". Include a legend with "Cost", "Admitted patient", and "Outpatient". Show the data across twelve months labeled from "1-Jan" through "1-Dec". Use literal series.data arrays: Cost [3500, 3200, 3600, 3400, 3800, 4100, 3700, 3900, 3600, 3300, 3400, 3550], Admitted patient [2200, 2100, 2300, 2250, 2400, 2600, 2350, 2450, 2300, 2200, 2250, 2350], and Outpatient [1400, 1350, 1450, 1380, 1500, 1550, 1480, 1520, 1430, 1390, 1410, 1470]. Render this as an ECharts combo chart using these literal data arrays.

Section 3: "Patient Satisfaction". Render this as an ECharts pie chart with three slices labeled "Excellent", "Okay", and "Poor". Use data percentages 53, 25, and 22 respectively, with literal data arrays.

Section 4: a metrics summary with three parts. First: heading "Total Patients", number "61,948", and a caption indicating admitted patients. Second: heading "Operational expense", figure "$15,856K", and the line "Avg Cost per Patient". Third: heading "Doctors", metric "24.79", and a caption about average patients per month.

Section 5: "Staff Per Department". Render this as an ECharts radar chart with axes for departments: Surgery, Orthopedics, Neurology, Gynecology, Cardiology, Oncology, Dermatology. Use one series with staff counts [30, 28, 22, 34, 26, 24, 20] as literal data in the ECharts configuration.

Section 6: "Average wait Times by Department". List departments vertically, each followed by its wait time in minutes: Cardiology 38, Concology 45, Dermatology 42, Gynaecology 50, Neurology 44, Orthopedics 38, Surgery 39.

Section 7: "Doctor's Treatment Plan". List these response categories in order with percentages: "Strongly Agree" 12%, "Agree" 7%, "Neutral" 46%, "Disagree" 10%, "Strongly Disagree" 7%.

Section 8: "Confidence in treatment". List the same five response categories in order with these percentages: "Strongly Agree" 14, "Agree" 72, "Neutral" 21, "Disagree" 17, "Strongly Disagree" 16.

No photographs, logos, complex illustrations, or placeholder images are required. Ensure all key labels and numbers described above appear as visible text nodes so they can be evaluated later.
